title: emergency.py: Unbounded rollcall storage enables memory exhaustion DoS
description:
RollcallResource.render_post() (lines 192-199) adds entries to self._rollcalls without any limit on count or expiration. An attacker can POST unlimited unique rollcall IDs to exhaust server memory. Contrast with SosResource which maintains only a single active state.

File: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/project-LICHEN/python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py
Line: 193
close_reason: Fixed: Added MAX_ROLLCALLS=256 limit and _prune_expired() method. render_post() now prunes expired entries and returns SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE if at limit. update() also prunes and silently drops if at limit. Expiration uses existing timeout_s field.
